summary: Uses attribute values from the first input as indices into attributes of a second lookup POP, then writes the looked-up values to existing or new output attributes.

key_params.name: lookupindexattr
key_params.note: Attribute values used as lookup indices

key_concepts: Uses lookup index attributes on the first input to sample value attributes from a second POP input.
Normalized index mode maps 0 to the first lookup point and 1 to the last; point-index mode uses element numbers.
Extend, cyclic, and interpolation controls define how out-of-range or between-point lookup indices are sampled.
Sequential lookup blocks can fetch multiple value attributes and rerange them before writing output scopes.
common_gotchas: Input index values are commonly normalized 0-1; Point Index mode changes semantics.
Extend Left and Extend Right determine out-of-range lookup behavior.
Sequential blocks can re-range each looked-up value before writing to output attributes.
